{{Top|leg}}
The '''Magna-lock safe''' was a type of [[safe]].<ref name="Fly Casual">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

Among the best safes on the market, Magna-lock safes were made out of multiple bonded layers of highest quality [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], with special [[Magna lock/Legends|locking mechanisms]] in the doors. When locked, the safe's door generated micromagnetic fields that created covalent bonds nearly as strong as the surrounding durasteel.<ref name="Fly Casual" />

Though magna-lock safes were variable in size, all required highly specialized tools to access by force, and even with these tools, required equally specialized knowledge to open.<ref name="Fly Casual" />
